description: Waze 5.25.0.1 (ARM64). Eight independent options: selectable map themes; selectable report icon packs; detailed report icons at normal sizes; local rank badge selector; unlock driver moods; Android Auto setup; adjustable Android Auto police alert distance; speed camera sound below the speed limit. Follow synchronous extraction helpers and delegated icon loaders across old and new Waze versions. Recognise badge artwork overloads and discover mood/badge owners without fixed class names. Missing, unmapped or differently sized icon assets produce warnings and retain Waze artwork; see Icon warnings in the icon-pack dialog. Hide unavailable badge choices and restore Automatic for removed saved badges. Preserve unknown native report groups without modifying their calls, while rejecting ambiguous or broken renderer detection. Add a 2023 seven-patch regression and altered-icon APK tests. Older inlined native icon sizing remains unsupported. Phone and Android Auto runtime testing is still required.
